checks.name: package
checks.run: s=$(xcrun simctl list devices | grep -F 'RetroPlay Build (' | grep -oE '[0-9A-F-]{36}' | head -1); [ -n "$s" ] || { echo 'No RetroPlay Build Simulator'; exit 1; }; xcrun simctl boot "$s" 2>/dev/null; xcrun simctl bootstatus "$s" >/dev/null && cd App && xcodebuild test -scheme RetroPlay-Package -destination id=$s -derivedDataPath ../build/dd-land/package -collect-test-diagnostics never -quiet; r=$?; xcrun simctl shutdown $s 2>/dev/null; exit $r
